summary: Pseudo-C for JNI_OnLoad (2148 lines, partly unstructured).

limitations.message: variables are machine registers and stack slots; types are not recovered
call arguments follow the usual arm64 convention and may be wrong for unusual functions
branch conditions are rebuilt from the last compare and may be approximate
10 gotos remain where the control flow isn't a simple if/loop
99 instructions have no C rule and are shown as __asm(...)
Ghidra's analysis has no function at this address and it couldn't make one: the address is not in executable memory. So this came from the built-in decompiler, which is less exact.
